answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 150469 Country: India Title: Zakat on property for which i have already given zakat. Question: I want to explain my question in an example: 1. Last year I had 100000 rupees and I also paid zakah for this. I have not used this money for one year and hence I have same amount currently. Do I need to pay its zakah again this year? 2. Last year I had 100000 rupees and I also paid zakah for it. Then I added another 100000 to it so currently my saving is 200000. Do I need to pay zakah for 200000 or just 100000? Answer ID: 150469 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 839/814/B=8/1438) (1) Yes, this year too you will have to pay the zakah of those rupees again. (2) Now you will have to pay the zakah of two lakh rupees; both the amount which was in your hand earlier and the income which came in your hand later. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
